# SplitMix64 source permission evidence

`UPSTREAM_PERMISSION_EXCERPT.txt` reproduces the permission and disclaimer
header shown in Sebastiano Vigna’s official reference at
<https://prng.di.unimi.it/splitmix.c> (read on 2026-11-21). The excerpt’s
SHA-256 is `0f6f53859363e787f1da76fb1bd04fdca581d836f644cdbbf4de3ea0ea41e773`.
It is a text excerpt recorded from the upstream page, not an independently
hash-verified copy of the complete upstream source. The phase1 generator uses
the same increment and output-mixing constants; its direct historical
derivation path has not been established.
